name: Accotink Creek near Annandale, VA
tagline: A 23-square-mile creek in suburban Fairfax County that can rise tenfold within hours of a thunderstorm.
about: Accotink Creek drains 23 square miles of suburban Northern Virginia, about 70% of it developed. Pavement sends storm runoff to the creek within hours, so floods are short and sharp, and they hinge on where and when thunderstorms hit. That makes it one of the hardest kinds of river to forecast more than a few hours out.
